High Court For The State Of Telangana
 At Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Between:
Mohammed Kaleemuddin  ...Petitioner/Accused No.1 AND The State of Telangana rep. by its Public Prosecutor & another  ...Respondents  ORDER 1.

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short, 'Cr.P.C) seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioner/accused No.1 in C.C.No.1400314 of 2018, on the file of the learned XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Nampally, Hyderabad, arising out of Crime No.603 of 2017 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 406 of IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text:
XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Ms.Asiya Tarannum, learned counsel representing Mr.Mohd. Fasiuddin, learned counsel on record for the petitioner/accused No.1 as well as Sri Arun Kumar Doddla, the ETD,J Crl.P.No.9107_2023 learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1- State.
3.

When the matter is taken up for hearing, learned petitioner's counsel has limited her argument to the extent of seeking a direction to the Trial Court for expeditious disposal of C.C.No.1400314 of 2018, on the file of the learned XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally,
Hyderabad.

entities.text:
XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally,
Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Considering the submission of the learned counsel and in view of the fact that the subject CC pertains to the year 2018, in view of the Circular instructions issued by the High Court time and again to prioritize disposal of matters which are pending for more than five years, this Court,
without going into the merits of the case, deems it appropriate to direct the learned Trial Court to complete the proceedings as expeditiously as possible.

5. Hence, the Criminal Petition is disposed of directing the learned Trial Court to dispose of C.C.No.1400314 of 2018, on the file of the learned XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Nampally, Hyderabad, as expeditiously as possible strictly in accordance with law.
